note: Ps53 the fool (corrected; twin of Ps14, Elohim for YHWH). Human corruption is the core: the nabal's inward denial of God (seat=heart), universal corruption (shachat/alach corrupt, taab abominable, avel iniquity, none does good), the absent understanding/seeking/knowledge, the evildoers who devour God's people (akal) and do not call on God, their sudden pachad dread and God-caused shame; closing longed-for rejoice/glad. God-qualifiers=5 (looks down, scatters, rejects, salvation, restores) source-linked to IB chars. Re-roled 4 spans role-reassess mis-tagged 'qualifier' that are HUMAN acts (sug fallen-away, paal work-evil, akal eat-up, chanah encamps). Every candidate roled.

dims.v: fool (nabal - the fool says no God)
issues in corruption and abominable deeds

'The FOOL (nabal) says in his heart, There is no God' — practical atheism, not intellectual denial; nabal (the moral fool, cf Ps14:1) the one who lives as if God does not see — the inward premise from which corruption and abominable deeds flow. Twin of Ps14 (here 'Elohim' for YHWH)
the heart itself (seat of the denial)
the seat where the fool denies God

'says in his HEART (leb), There is no God' — the inner chamber where God is denied; leb the seat of thought/will, here the private place the fool tells himself there is no God — the denial is not spoken aloud but lived out from within
corrupt / act ruinously (shachat - they are corrupt)
paired with abominable iniquity; echoed in v3 (alach)

'They are CORRUPT (shachat), doing abominable iniquity' — the moral rot that follows the denial of God; shachat (ruin/spoil) the corruption of those who live godless, restated in v3 (alach) — the whole race turned rotten

'doing ABOMINABLE (taab) iniquity' — deeds that are loathsome to God; taab (to be detestable) the character of the fools' works — not merely wrong but abhorrent, the outward face of the God-denying heart
'doing abominable INIQUITY (avel)' — the injustice/perversity that is the substance of the abominable deeds; avel here the moral wrong the fools practise, the concrete content of their corruption
understand / be wise (sakal - any who understand)

'to see if there are any who UNDERSTAND (sakal)' — the God-ward wisdom God searches for and (v3) finds absent; sakal (to be prudent/wise) the insight that seeks God — the very faculty the fool lacks, twinned with seeking after God
seek / inquire after (darash - who seek after God)
the object of God's looking down from heaven (v2)

'who SEEK (darash) after God' — the Godward searching God looks down to find; darash (to seek/inquire) the pursuit of God that, in the whole godless race, God's own gaze (the qualifier, v2) discovers in no one — 'they have all fallen away' (v3)
turn back / fall away (sug - they have all fallen away)

'They have all FALLEN AWAY (sug)' — the universal human defection from God; sug (to turn back/apostatize) the whole race's turning away — the answer to God's search of v2: not one seeks him, all have drawn back together

'together they have BECOME CORRUPT (alach)' — the whole turned rancid; alach (to be tainted/sour, like spoiled milk) the moral corruption of v1 now spread to all together — a corporate rottenness, none exempt

'Have those who WORK (paal) evil no knowledge?' — the settled practice of evil; paal (to do/make) here the working of iniquity as a way of life, done by those who 'have no knowledge' — evildoing joined to a wilful ignorance of God
'workers of EVIL (aven)' — the iniquity/mischief that is the evildoers' trade; aven (trouble/wickedness) the substance of what they work, those who devour God's people and never call on him
the knowledge the workers of evil lack

'Have those who work evil no KNOWLEDGE (yada)?' — the moral/spiritual ignorance of the wicked; yada here the knowing of God that the evildoers lack — willed blindness, the counterpart to the fool's 'no God' — devouring God's people as though he did not see
eat up / devour (akal - eat up my people)
as they eat bread (casually, as food)
paired with not calling upon God

'who EAT UP (akal) my people as they eat bread' — predatory cruelty made routine; akal here the devouring of God's people as casually as one eats a meal — oppression without conscience, joined to a refusal to call on God
call upon (qara - do not call upon God)

'and do not CALL (qara) upon God' — the prayerlessness that marks the godless; qara here the invocation of God the evildoers refuse — the practical expression of 'no God' (v1): they neither seek nor call on him, only prey on his people
be in dread / terror (pachad - in great terror)
great, such as has never been
because God scatters the bones of the besieger (v5)

'There they are in great TERROR (pachad), in terror such as has not been!' — the sudden groundless dread that overtakes the godless; pachad (dread/panic) the collapse of the confident wicked into terror — because God scatters their forces (the qualifier), those who feared nothing are seized by unprecedented fear
be put to shame (bosh - you put them to shame)

'you put them to SHAME (bosh), for God has rejected them' — the disgrace of the godless when their confidence collapses; bosh here the enemies' shame — the inner ruin of exposure and defeat, grounded in God's rejection of them (the qualifier)
rejoice / spin with joy (gil - let Jacob rejoice)
when God restores his people's fortunes / brings salvation from Zion (v6)

'let Jacob REJOICE (gil), let Israel be glad' — the joy the psalm longs for when God delivers; gil (spinning joy) the exultation of restored Israel — the hoped-for reversal, joy replacing the fools' corruption, when salvation comes out of Zion (the qualifier)
be glad (samach - let Israel be glad)
'let Israel be GLAD (samach)' — the gladness twinned with rejoicing at deliverance; samach the joy of the redeemed people, the psalm's closing hope over against the terror and shame of the wicked
look down (shaqaph - God looks down from heaven)
God's searching gaze, seeking any who seek him (v2)

v2 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'God LOOKS DOWN (shaqaph) from heaven on the children of man' - God's searching gaze is not a human IB char; the divine looking that seeks any who understand and seek him (279903) - and finds none. Qualifier.
God's scattering of the besiegers, cause of their terror (v5)

v5 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'God SCATTERS (pazar) the bones of him who encamps against you' - God's routing of the enemy is not a human IB char; the divine act that plunges the confident wicked into terror (279928). Qualifier.
reject / spurn (maas - God has rejected them)
God's rejection, ground of the enemies' shame (v5)
v5 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'for God has REJECTED (maas) them' - God's spurning is not a human IB char; the divine verdict that grounds the enemies' shame (279936). Qualifier.
the longed-for salvation from Zion, ground of the coming joy (v6)

v6 QUALIFIER (God's salvation): 'Oh that SALVATION (yeshuah) for Israel would come out of Zion!' - God's deliverance is not a human IB char; the awaited rescue whose arrival will make Jacob rejoice (279952). Qualifier.
restore / bring back (shub - restores the fortunes)
God's restoring of his people, occasion of their joy (v6)

v6 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'When God RESTORES (shub) the fortunes of his people' - God's restoring is not a human IB char; the divine reversal that occasions Jacob's rejoicing and Israel's gladness (279952). Qualifier.

v1: 'there is none who does GOOD (tob)' - the good-doing that is universally absent; the moral good whose absence measures the corruption (captured in the corrupt/abominable chars), a contrast/absence object, not itself a disposition present in anyone. Standalone.
good (tob - none who does good, not one)
v3: 'there is none who does GOOD (tob), not even one' - the emphatic restatement of v1: the absent good-doing across the whole race; a contrast/absence object (cf Ps14:3, quoted Rom 3). Standalone.

v4: 'eat up my people as they EAT (akal) bread' - the simile of casualness for the devouring of God's people (279919); the comparison-image, its force carried into the eat-up char's manner. Standalone (simile).
v5: 'in GREAT terror' - the magnitude of the dread that seizes the wicked (279928), carried in the terror char's manner dim; an intensifier, not a distinct operation. Standalone.
dread / terror (pachad noun - such as has not been)

v5: 'in terror (pachad) such as has not been' - the restatement intensifying the dread of 279928 ('terror such as never was'); the same panic, its unprecedented degree carried in that char's manner. Standalone (restatement).
encamp / besiege (chanah - him who encamps against you)

v5: 'the bones of him who ENCAMPS (chanah) against you' - the besieger's outward military act against God's people; a physical act of the enemy (whom God scatters), not an inner operation. Standalone.

v6: 'restores the FORTUNES (shebuth) of his people' - the people's restored estate/return from captivity; the object of God's restoring (279948), an outward condition, not an inner operation. Standalone.
